The base protein level of ENO1 in normal samples is **72,900,000** (7.29 × 10⁷), rounded to 3 significant figures.

This value is read directly from the "Normal" column of the "Tumor vs Normal" sheet in Proteomic_data.xlsx (row 473, protein P06733, gene ENO1, gene_id 2023). The raw value is 72,896,133.2946858.

**Assumption:** "Base protein level" is interpreted as the aggregated protein abundance in the normal cohort, as stored in the `Normal` column. The unit is unspecified in the header (likely LFQ/iBAQ-type quantification intensity). No unit conversion or log transformation is applied; the value is reported as-is. Only the single ENO1 row (P06733) is used; ENO2/ENO3 are distinct genes and excluded.
